quantile_selection_rule: the probe's benign budget on the fit half must not exceed L1's own measured benign rate (Alpaca FPR 0.0300), so adding a tier cannot spend more false-positive budget than the layer already had
held_out_rationale: WildJailbreak, TensorTrust and sentinel_bench carry every claim this probe is evaluated against and are never fitted on. Alpaca is split: rows 500-2000 fit, rows 0-500 evaluate, disjoint by construction. JailbreakBench is a reported L1 row and is RETIRED as a zero-shot row for this component by being fitted on -- see the module docstring.
